coding_context.reported_success_quote: Our replication findings based on dichotomous numeracy suggest support for numeracy as a predictor of framing effect (Study 1), ratio bias (Study 3), and bets effect (Study 4). When treating numeracy as a continuous variable, all four studies (including Study 2’s frequency-percentage effect) could be regarded as successful.
